Potassium formate serves as the single-electron-transfer reagent and tert-butyl nitrite as a HAT reagent, with the reported method showing broad functional-group tolerance and high stereoselectivity for the conjugated terminal alkene. Captured optimization data show that potassium formate is critical and DMSO is strongly preferred; 390–405 nm purple light is most effective, 450–465 nm blue light gives only trace product, and no reaction occurs without light. These observations support a wavelength-dependent, visible-light-initiated radical process.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03980.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的底物范围和完整机理细节不作补写。该研究报道 Rh 催化的 alkyne-tethered ketoester 与 arylboronic acid 不对称 1,4-shift/double-cyclization 串联，一步形成 3 个新键和 2 个环，从头构建手性 spirolactone。捕获的优化数据表明，手性配体、溶剂与碱共同决定效率和对映选择性，代表性优化结果可达到约 70% 收率和 94:6 er。作者的机理研究支持关键的 1,4-Rh 迁移步骤，随后连续成环建立螺环骨架；所得 spirolactone 还可继续转化为多类手性 spirocycle。该方法的合成价值在于把芳基迁移与双重成环压缩到单一催化级联中。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03980.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured substrate-scope and complete mechanistic details are not reconstructed. The study reports a Rh-catalyzed asymmetric 1,4-shift/double-cyclization cascade between alkyne-tethered ketoesters and arylboronic acids, forming three new bonds and two rings in one operation to construct chiral spirolactones de novo. The captured optimization data show that the chiral ligand, solvent, and base jointly control efficiency and enantioselectivity, with representative optimized results reaching about 70% yield and 94:6 er. Mechanistic studies support a key 1,4-rhodium shift followed by sequential cyclizations that establish the spirocyclic framework, and the resulting spirolactones can be converted into additional chiral spirocycles. The synthetic value lies in compressing aryl migration and double ring formation into a single catalytic cascade.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03963.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的底物范围与生物评价细节不作补写。该研究发展了 Mn 介导的 indole isocyanide、diarylphosphine oxide 与水的级联环化，一步构建含 C–C、C–O 和 C–P 新键的 indolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline，并可通过条件切换获得不同杂原子取代模式。优化数据展示了明显的发散控制：Mn(OAc)2·4H2O/TMEDA/MeCN 条件主要给一类产物（模型体系约 74% 分离收率），而 Mn(OAc)3·2H2O/K2CO3/MeCN 可把选择性切换到另一类产物（约 70% 分离收率）。摘要与捕获内容指出反应具有较好区域/化学选择性和官能团兼容性，机理研究支持自由基路径；产物还被用于后期衍生化并进行了初步生物活性评价。该方法提供了利用 Mn 氧化态/配体-碱组合控制同一底物体系分流的杂环构建策略。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03963.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured substrate-scope and biological-evaluation details are not reconstructed. The study develops a Mn-mediated cascade cyclization of indole isocyanides, diarylphosphine oxides, and water to build indolo[1,2-a]quinoxalines while forming C–C, C–O, and C–P bonds in one operation, with reaction conditions controlling distinct heteroatom-substitution modes. The captured optimization data show clear divergence: Mn(OAc)2·4H2O/TMEDA in MeCN mainly gives one product class at about 74% isolated yield in the model system, whereas Mn(OAc)3·2H2O/K2CO3 in MeCN switches selectivity to the other class at about 70% isolated yield. The captured material describes good regio- and chemoselectivity and useful functional-group tolerance, while mechanistic studies support a radical pathway; late-stage derivatization and preliminary biological evaluation were also reported. The method therefore uses manganese oxidation state and ligand/base choice to direct one substrate manifold into alternative heterocyclic products.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03908.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展光氧化还原催化的 dehydroalanine 及含 Dha 二肽二氟甲基化，以 difluoromethyl sulfone 为自由基前体，在温和条件下直接获得 β-difluoromethyl α-amino acid 衍生物。概念验证的手性磷酸参与不对称版本给出模型产物 55% 分离收率和 73% ee。机理实验支持自由基–极性交叉，并提示产物可逆去质子化可能导致立体化学侵蚀。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03908.en: Abstract-based: a photoredox-catalyzed difluoromethylation of dehydroalanine derivatives and protected Dha-containing dipeptides uses a difluoromethyl sulfone radical precursor to access β-difluoromethyl α-amino-acid derivatives under mild conditions. A proof-of-concept chiral-phosphoric-acid-enabled variant gives the model product in 55% isolated yield and 73% ee. Mechanistic experiments support a radical–polar crossover pathway and suggest that reversible product deprotonation may contribute to erosion of stereochemical integrity.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03905.zh: 基于 Abstract：作者通过共价连接 indole 电子给体与 NHPI ester 电子受体，构建分子内 EDA 复合物，在可见光下实现一锅脱羧环化级联，并在无金属、无外加光催化剂的中性温和条件下组装 Corynanthe 型生物碱的 6/5/6/6 四环核心。摘要报道 22 个例子、68–98% 收率和克级放大；该反应被用于 (+)-hirsutinol 与 (−)-dihydrocorynantheol 的 8 步对映选择性全合成。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03905.en: Abstract-based: covalently tethering an indole donor to an NHPI-ester acceptor creates an intramolecular EDA complex that undergoes a visible-light-driven one-pot decarboxylative cyclization cascade. Under neutral, metal- and photocatalyst-free conditions, the reaction constructs the characteristic 6/5/6/6 tetracyclic core of corynanthe-type alkaloids. The abstract reports 22 examples in 68–98% yield, gram-scale operation, and use of the transformation in 8-linear-step enantioselective total syntheses of (+)-hirsutinol and (−)-dihydrocorynantheol.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03808.zh: 基于 Abstract：该工作设计并合成 methylene 与 difluoromethylene uridine bisphosphonate-carbagalactose，作为更稳定的 UDP-galactose 模拟物，用稳定结构替代易水解的糖苷键和焦磷酸连接。研究还实现了 secondary triflate 与 difluoromethylene bisphosphonate 的亲核取代，为糖核苷酸模拟物合成提供新方法。两种 UDP-Gal 类似物均抑制 A4GALT，在 500 μM UDP-Gal 存在时 IC50 分别为 249 和 217 μM。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03808.en: Abstract-based: methylene- and difluoromethylene-uridine bisphosphonate carbagalactoses were designed and synthesized as chemically and enzymatically stabilized UDP-galactose mimics in which labile glycosidic and pyrophosphate linkages are replaced by robust motifs. The work also demonstrates nucleophilic substitution of a secondary triflate with a difluoromethylene bisphosphonate, providing a route to related sugar-nucleotide mimics. The two analogues inhibit A4GALT with IC50 values of 249 and 217 μM, respectively, in the presence of 500 μM UDP-Gal.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03409.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。作者以廉价烯烃和双亲核体为原料，发展电化学模块化合成 piperazine 与 1,4-diazepane 的方法。反应序列通过阳极氧化和连续亲核进攻两次形成 C–N 键，以电子作为无痕氧化剂，在温和条件下实现多种碳取代饱和含氮杂环，并表现出较宽官能团耐受性。当前未捕获到足以可靠补写更细机理与范围数据的正文部分。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03409.en: The captured evidence is partial. A modular electrochemical synthesis converts inexpensive alkenes and bisnucleophiles into functionalized piperazines and 1,4-diazepanes. Sequential anodic oxidation and nucleophilic attack forge two C–N bonds, using electrons as traceless oxidants under mild conditions with broad functional-group tolerance. The captured material does not support reconstruction of additional detailed mechanistic or scope data beyond these reported features.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01674.zh: 作者发展无过渡金属、碱促进的一锅级联环化，以 isatogen 与 2-(2-aminophenyl)acetonitrile 同时构建 C–C、C–N 和 N–N 键，制备 indazolo[2,3-a]quinoline。模型反应优化至 Cs2CO3（1 equiv）/MeCN、室温条件，得到 90% 收率；方法具有较宽底物范围与官能团耐受性并可放大。产物显示明显荧光，且可进一步经 Rh 催化环合转化为高度稠合的 cinnolinium salts。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01674.en: A transition-metal-free, base-promoted one-pot cascade between isatogens and 2-(2-aminophenyl)acetonitriles forms C–C, C–N, and N–N bonds to access indazolo[2,3-a]quinolines. The model reaction was optimized to 1 equiv Cs2CO3 in MeCN at room temperature, giving 90% yield; the method shows broad scope, useful functional-group tolerance, and scalability. The products display notable fluorescence and can undergo a subsequent Rh-catalyzed annulation to highly fused cinnolinium salts.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01138.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用由天然萜类构成的疏水深共熔溶剂作为高沸点反应介质，重新实现热驱动 aziridine–alkene 环加成，以原子经济方式制备高取代 pyrrolidine。多种 N-aryl aziridine 可作为 azomethine ylide 前体，最高分离收率 94%。方法还扩展到从 azide 起始物的一锅双环加成，并展示了溶剂重复使用和克级合成。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01138.en: Abstract-based: hydrophobic deep eutectic solvents prepared from naturally occurring terpenoids serve as high-boiling media for an atom-economic thermal aziridine–alkene cycloaddition to highly substituted pyrrolidines. A broad range of N-aryl aziridines act as azomethine-ylide precursors, giving up to 94% isolated yield. The method is extended to a one-pot double cycloaddition from an azide starting material and includes solvent reuse and gram-scale synthesis.

10.1021/jacs.6c16285.zh: 该工作报道 o-carborane 与醇之间直接 B–H/O–H 交叉偶联，在异配体 Cu(I) 光催化下实现高度区域选择性的 B(4)–H 烷氧基化。苯甲酰导向基放大 B(3)–H 与 B(4)–H 键能差异，使 1,5-HAT 选择性生成 B 中心自由基；随后 Cu 介导的自由基–极性交叉把其转化为亲电性硼正离子中间体，再被醇捕获形成 B–O 键。自由基捕获、EPR、同位素/KIE 与光物理、电化学实验共同支持该机制，且伯、仲、叔醇及复杂醇均可参与。
10.1021/jacs.6c16285.en: A heteroleptic Cu(I) photocatalytic system enables the first direct B–H/O–H cross-coupling of o-carboranes with alcohols, giving highly regioselective B(4)–H alkoxylation. A benzoyl directing group amplifies the B(3)–H/B(4)–H bond-strength difference so that 1,5-HAT selectively generates a boron-centered radical; Cu-mediated radical–polar crossover then forms an electrophilic boron cation that is trapped by alcohols to give B–O bonds. Radical trapping, EPR, isotope/KIE, photophysical, and electrochemical studies support the mechanism, and primary, secondary, tertiary, and complex alcohols are compatible.

10.1038/s44160-026-01162-w.zh: 作者建立光电化学 Fe/Ni 双催化平台，把光诱导 LMCT 产生烷基自由基与电化学维持催化氧化态分离，从未预活化的羧酸、醇和醛直接实现选择性 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 偶联。双脱羧模型体系在 390 nm 光、恒流 3 mA 和室温下工作；关键 sacrificial alkyl bromide 消耗过量电子，抑制 Ni(II) 过还原为 Ni(I)，维持 Ni(II)/Ni(III) 循环。EPR、CV 和产物立体化学分析支持 Ni 介导的 SH2 radical sorting，从而跨越伯、仲、叔碳自由基实现交叉偶联。
10.1038/s44160-026-01162-w.en: A photoelectrochemical Fe/Ni dual-catalytic platform decouples LMCT-based alkyl-radical generation from electrochemical maintenance of the catalytic redox state, enabling selective C(sp3)–C(sp3) coupling directly from unactivated carboxylic acids, alcohols, and aldehydes. The double-decarboxylative model reaction operates under 390 nm light at 3 mA constant current and room temperature. A sacrificial alkyl bromide consumes excess cathodic electrons, suppressing over-reduction of Ni(II) to Ni(I) and sustaining a Ni(II)/Ni(III) cycle. EPR, CV, and product-selectivity studies support Ni-mediated SH2 radical sorting across primary, secondary, and tertiary carbon radicals.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03422.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。作者由 tetrazine 基二铵前体与多种富氮/富氧高能阴离子配对，制得一系列热稳定 energetic salts。摘要中化合物 9 在能量性能与稳定性之间表现出最佳平衡，给出爆速 8533 m s−1、爆压 27.09 GPa、分解温度 207 °C 和撞击感度 12.5 J，其能量性能与 RDX 相当。该结果表明 tetrazine-derived diammonium cation 可作为兼顾热稳定性与高能性能的离子型材料设计平台。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03422.en: The captured evidence is partial. A tetrazine-derived diammonium precursor is paired with nitrogen- and oxygen-rich energetic anions to generate a family of thermally stable energetic salts. In the captured abstract, compound 9 provides the best reported balance of performance and stability, with a detonation velocity of 8533 m s−1, detonation pressure of 27.09 GPa, decomposition temperature of 207 °C, and impact sensitivity of 12.5 J, giving energetic performance comparable to RDX. The work positions tetrazine-derived diammonium cations as a platform for balancing thermal stability and energetic output.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05151.zh: 该研究颠覆 1,7-enyne 常见的环化双官能团化模式，发展 Cu 催化的线性远程双官能团化。Togni reagent 产生的 CF3 自由基优先加成 C=C，随后经 1,5-HAT 形成 propargyl/allenyl 自由基并由 TMSCN 捕获，得到远程含 CF3 的 allenenitrile；体系还观察到 1,6- 和 1,7-HAT。机理研究支持“自由基加成–HAT–sp3/sp2 切换–Cu 偶联”序列，且方法具有较宽官能团兼容性并可进一步衍生。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05151.en: This work departs from the usual cyclizative difunctionalization of 1,7-enynes by developing a Cu-catalyzed linear remote double functionalization. A CF3 radical generated from a Togni reagent adds selectively to the alkene, followed by 1,5-HAT to a propargyl/allenyl radical and trapping with TMSCN to give remotely CF3-substituted allenenitriles; 1,6- and 1,7-HAT variants are also observed. Mechanistic studies support a radical-addition/HAT/sp3-to-sp2 switch/Cu-coupling sequence, and the products retain diverse functional groups for downstream chemistry.

10.1021/acscatal.6c04883.zh: 该研究发展了光辅助 Ir 催化 C–H 硼化。与暗条件相比，光照可显著提高多类底物的转化效率，而区域选择性基本保持不变；流动化学实验也显示该模式可缩短停留时间。控制实验和计算不支持单电子转移或 EDA 复合物主导路径，作者据此提出光激发主要促进配体解离和活性 Ir 催化物种的生成，从而加速常规 C–H 硼化循环。
10.1021/acscatal.6c04883.en: This study develops a light-assisted iridium-catalyzed C–H borylation. Illumination substantially improves conversion across many substrates relative to the dark reaction while largely preserving regioselectivity, and flow experiments show that the light-assisted mode can shorten residence time. Control experiments and computations do not support a dominant single-electron-transfer or EDA pathway; the authors instead propose that photoexcitation facilitates ligand dissociation and formation of the active iridium catalyst, thereby accelerating the conventional C–H borylation cycle.

10.31635/ccschem.026.202507282.zh: 该研究利用协同非共价相互作用实现未活化二烯与一级芳香胺的区域选择性顺序氧化胺化。第一步通过选择性烯丙位 C–H 胺化建立支链烯丙胺，随后可经 aza-Wacker 环化或第二次胺化，分别构建吡咯烷、四氢吲哚及相关含氮骨架。机理实验支持烯丙位胺化先于后续环化；作者将区域控制归因于底物与催化体系之间的 π 相互作用以及阴离子配体参与的氢键/配位协同。
10.31635/ccschem.026.202507282.en: This work uses cooperative noncovalent interactions to achieve regioselective sequential oxidative amination of unactivated dienes with primary aromatic amines. Selective allylic C–H amination first establishes a branched allylamine, which can then undergo aza-Wacker cyclization or a second amination to furnish pyrrolidine, tetrahydroindole, and related nitrogen-containing frameworks. Mechanistic experiments support allylic amination preceding the downstream cyclization, and the authors attribute the regioselectivity to cooperative π interactions together with hydrogen-bonding/coordination involving the anionic ligand.

10.31635/ccschem.026.202507094.zh: 该研究以 N-氟代羧酰胺远端 C(sp³)–H 键为烷基自由基来源，实现 Cu 催化未活化烯烃的发散官能化。N 中心自由基经 1,5-HAT 生成碳自由基并加成烯烃；通过改变后续捕获方式，可得到反 Markovnikov 氢烷基化或 1,2-烷基炔基化产物。实验结果支持自由基加成后进入 Cu 参与的氧化/还原消除过程，而含硅氢源的条件切换可导向氢官能化分支。
10.31635/ccschem.026.202507094.en: This study uses the remote C(sp3)–H bond of N-fluorocarboxamides as an alkyl-radical source for divergent copper-catalyzed functionalization of unactivated alkenes. An N-centered radical undergoes 1,5-HAT to generate a carbon radical that adds to the alkene; changing the downstream trapping mode gives either anti-Markovnikov hydroalkylation or 1,2-alkylalkynylation products. The experimental data support radical addition followed by copper-mediated oxidation/reductive elimination, while switching to a silane-containing condition directs the process toward hydrofunctionalization.

10.1002/anie.9826344.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该工作解析了酰基转移酶 AntB 同时容忍酰基供体和受体的结构与机理基础，并将其用于天然产物后期多样化。捕获证据显示 AntB 可接受多类受体和数十种酰基供体，定向改造获得的 S17A/M265L 变体进一步提高特定底物酰化活性；与工程化 Acyl-CoA 合成酶串联后，可一锅生成多种非天然 UK-2A 类似物。结构分析显示 HXXXDG 催化基序和较开放的活性位点共同支撑这种双底物宽容性。
10.1002/anie.9826344.en: The captured evidence is partial. This work defines the structural and mechanistic basis for the dual donor/acceptor promiscuity of the acyltransferase AntB and applies it to late-stage diversification of natural products. The captured evidence shows that AntB accepts multiple acceptors and dozens of acyl donors, while the engineered S17A/M265L variant further improves acylation of a selected substrate. Coupling AntB with engineered acyl-CoA synthetases enables one-pot preparation of diverse non-natural UK-2A analogues. Structural analysis implicates the HXXXDG catalytic motif together with a spacious active site in the observed dual-substrate tolerance.

10.1002/anie.9277033.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究发展了手性双噁唑啉配体支持的 Ni 催化还原不对称加成，将芳基、杂芳基和烯基卤化物加到脂肪族醛亚胺上，获得高对映选择性的胺类产物。体系覆盖较广的芳基化和烯基化底物，并可在较低 Ni 负载下运行。机理与计算结果支持芳基-Ni(I) 物种对亚胺发生 1,2-插入；Mn 还原剂以及促进还原步骤的钛醇盐对高效催化具有重要作用。
10.1002/anie.9277033.en: The captured evidence is partial. A chiral bis(oxazoline)-supported nickel catalyst enables reductive enantioselective addition of aryl, heteroaryl, and alkenyl halides to aliphatic aldimines, furnishing amine products with high enantioselectivity. The reaction covers broad arylation and alkenylation scope and can operate at relatively low nickel loading. Mechanistic and computational results support 1,2-insertion of the imine into an aryl–Ni(I) species, while the manganese reductant and a titanium alkoxide that facilitates reductive steps are important for efficient catalysis.

10.1002/anie.8881851.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究鉴定并组合利用红花来源糖基转移酶，建立黄酮 6-O-糖苷的组合生物合成平台。Ct6OGT 对 6-O 位表现出高选择性，并可与 Ct7OGT、Ct3OGT 和黄酮醇合成酶等模块串联，通过顺序糖基化构建多种黄酮糖苷。捕获证据还显示部分产物在斑马鱼模型中表现出抗血栓活性，为稀有 6-O-糖基化黄酮的制备和结构–活性探索提供了酶法路径。
10.1002/anie.8881851.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study identifies and combines glycosyltransferases from Carthamus tinctorius to establish a combinatorial biosynthetic platform for flavonoid 6-O-glycosides. Ct6OGT shows high selectivity for the 6-O position and can be coupled with Ct7OGT, Ct3OGT, flavonol synthase, and related modules to build diverse flavonoid glycosides through sequential glycosylation. The captured evidence also reports antithrombotic activity for selected products in a zebrafish model, providing an enzymatic route to rare 6-O-glycosylated flavonoids and subsequent structure–activity studies.

10.1002/anie.8050538.zh: 该研究建立了炔烃的直接二氟亚甲基化，将多类炔烃转化为烯丙基二氟化物。体系以多聚甲醛和高浓度 HF/吡啶提供二氟亚甲基单元，反应具有较广底物范围并可放大。光谱与计算研究支持先形成含氟甲基氧鎓/氧碳正离子型亲电中间体，再与炔烃反应并经后续氟化生成产物，为从简单炔烃快速构建 allyl-CF₂ 结构提供了直接方法。
10.1002/anie.8050538.en: This study establishes a direct difluoromethylenation of alkynes to give allylic difluorides. Paraformaldehyde together with concentrated HF/pyridine provides the difluoromethylene unit, and the transformation shows broad substrate scope and can be scaled. Spectroscopic and computational studies support formation of a fluoromethyl oxocarbenium-type electrophile that reacts with the alkyne before subsequent fluorination, providing a direct route from simple alkynes to allylic CF2-containing structures.

10.1002/anie.7400940.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究制备了可分离、可储存的 α-硝基氮杂环丙烷，并将其作为酮亚胺中间体的稳定前体。温和碱性活化后，α-硝基氮杂环丙烷释放酮亚胺，可被 N、O 或 C 亲核体捕获，也可进入环化和环加成过程，从而快速扩展产物类型。同位素实验、亚硝酸盐定量、原位红外、独立中间体实验和计算共同支持“开环/消除生成酮亚胺”的作者机理模型。
10.1002/anie.7400940.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study prepares isolable, storable α-nitroaziridines and uses them as stable precursors to ketenimines. Mild basic activation releases a ketenimine that can be trapped by N-, O-, or C-nucleophiles or engaged in cyclization and cycloaddition reactions, rapidly expanding accessible product classes. Isotope experiments, nitrite quantification, in situ IR, independent-intermediate experiments, and computations collectively support the authors’ ring-opening/elimination model for ketenimine generation.

10.1002/anie.7232174.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该工作利用受阻 Lewis 酸碱对修饰的 CoOx 催化剂活化 O₂，实现聚乙烯氧化升级为二羧酸等含氧小分子。捕获证据显示该表面位点可促进超氧物种形成并明显提高碳收率；EPR、自由基淬灭与计算结果共同支持 O₂ 自由基参与的链式氧化过程。该策略把表面酸碱协同用于惰性聚烯烃 C–H 活化，为塑料氧化升级提供了异相催化路径。
10.1002/anie.7232174.en: The captured evidence is partial. Frustrated-Lewis-pair-modified CoOx activates O2 for oxidative upcycling of polyethylene to dicarboxylic acids and related oxygenated products. The captured evidence indicates that these surface sites promote superoxide formation and substantially improve carbon yield, while EPR, radical-quenching experiments, and computations support participation of O2-derived radicals in the oxidation sequence. The strategy applies cooperative surface acid/base chemistry to otherwise inert polyolefin C–H bonds, providing a heterogeneous route for oxidative plastic upcycling.

10.1002/anie.4827662.zh: 该研究发展了可见光光氧化还原驱动的酚衍生物到 β-芳基丙酸类化合物的转化。含氟烷基或磺酰基自由基先加成到烯基受体，随后发生 1,4-芳基迁移和 C–O 键断裂；作者提出后续自由基–极性交叉有助于抑制脱羧副反应。该方法覆盖多种酚衍生底物，并可用于复杂分子的后期改造，为把易得酚类骨架重编辑为 β-芳基羧酸提供了模块化光化学方案。
10.1002/anie.4827662.en: This study develops a visible-light photoredox conversion of phenol derivatives into β-arylpropionic-acid products. Fluoroalkyl or sulfonyl radicals add to an alkene acceptor, followed by 1,4-aryl migration and C–O bond cleavage; the authors propose that a subsequent radical–polar crossover helps suppress decarboxylation. The method covers diverse phenol-derived substrates and is applicable to late-stage modification of complex molecules, providing a modular photochemical route for skeletal editing of phenol-derived frameworks into β-aryl carboxylic acids.

10.1002/anie.4613575.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究以“一锅顺序催化”实现乙烯基连接共价有机框架的孔壁功能化：酸催化的 Schiff 碱过程先把功能化单醛与苄基二胺连接，随后切换到碱催化 Knoevenagel 缩合完成框架构筑。该方法获得一系列保持结晶性的功能化 COF，并允许引入多种孔壁基团。机理模型表明前一步亚胺形成/活化是实现选择性顺序反应的重要基础。
10.1002/anie.4613575.en: The captured evidence is partial. This work uses one-pot sequential catalysis for pore-wall functionalization of vinylene-linked covalent organic frameworks. An acid-catalyzed Schiff-base step first connects a functional monoaldehyde with a benzylic diamine, after which switching to base-catalyzed Knoevenagel condensation completes framework formation. The method provides a series of crystalline functionalized COFs bearing diverse pore-wall groups. Mechanistic model studies indicate that controlled imine formation/activation in the first stage is important for the selective sequential process.

10.1002/anie.1701592.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究利用芳香 Pummerer 活化实现噻唑与硼酸酯的立体专一性交叉偶联。带有邻位亚硫酰基辅助基的噻唑在活化后发生 1,2-迁移，将硼酸酯中的 C(sp³) 片段转移到噻唑 C5 位，并基本完整保留起始硼酸酯的立体信息；噻唑 C2 位硫基还能作为后续官能化把手。该方法因此提供了无需过渡金属、可立体专一构建杂芳基–烷基键的途径。
10.1002/anie.1701592.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study uses aromatic Pummerer activation for stereospecific cross-coupling of thiazoles with boronic esters. Activation of a thiazole bearing a pendant sulfinyl auxiliary triggers a 1,2-migration that transfers the C(sp3) fragment of the boronic ester to the thiazole C5 position while largely preserving the stereochemical information of the starting boronic ester. The C2 sulfur substituent remains available as a downstream functional handle, providing a transition-metal-free route to stereospecific heteroaryl–alkyl bond construction.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究通过 Ag 催化级联反应快速构建 pyran-fused indole 伪天然产物，并由不同底物组合获得多类稠合杂环骨架。捕获证据显示该方法具有较宽底物范围，部分代表性产物在多种肿瘤细胞中表现出微摩尔级抑制活性；进一步生物学实验显示候选化合物可诱导细胞周期阻滞、凋亡并抑制迁移。其主要合成价值在于把简单前体高效转化为具有三维复杂度的 indopyran 骨架库。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.en: The captured evidence is partial. A silver-catalyzed cascade reaction rapidly constructs pyran-fused indole pseudo-natural products and gives several classes of fused heterocyclic scaffolds from different substrate combinations. The captured evidence reports micromolar growth-inhibitory activity for selected products in multiple tumor cell lines, with follow-up experiments showing cell-cycle arrest, apoptosis, and inhibition of migration for a lead compound. The principal synthetic value is rapid conversion of simple precursors into a structurally diverse, three-dimensional indopyran library.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该工作发展了黄酮的电化学发散转化，通过改变电解质/溶剂体系，可选择性得到二氢黄酮醇或 3-碘代黄酮。反应在未分隔电解池、空气和室温附近条件下进行，不依赖外加化学氧化剂或过渡金属。控制实验和关键中间体研究支持阳极氧化后由不同亲核/碘化路径分流，为同一黄酮平台的可切换后期官能化提供了电合成方案。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.en: The captured evidence is partial. This work develops divergent electrochemical transformations of flavonoids in which changing the electrolyte/solvent system selectively affords either dihydroflavonols or 3-iodoflavones. The reactions are performed in an undivided cell under air at approximately room temperature without an external chemical oxidant or transition metal. Control experiments and studies of key intermediates support divergence after anodic oxidation into distinct nucleophilic or iodination pathways, providing a switchable electrochemical platform for late-stage modification of flavonoids.

10.1038/s41586-026-11108-z.zh: 该研究将烷基 thianthrenium 盐转化为稳定的 thianthrenium ylide，并把这类 ylide 作为通用卡宾转移试剂。以 Fe 催化烯烃环丙烷化为主要展示，体系兼容多类烯烃和卡宾片段，并可在溶液或固相研磨条件下操作。机理上，ylide 充当可控卡宾前体而 thianthrene 作为离去片段；作者还展示了 C–H/杂原子键插入和重排类反应，说明该平台可把易制备的 thianthrenium 盐扩展为模块化卡宾化学入口。
10.1038/s41586-026-11108-z.en: This study converts alkyl thianthrenium salts into stable thianthrenium ylides and uses these ylides as general carbene-transfer reagents. Iron-catalyzed alkene cyclopropanation is the principal demonstration, with broad compatibility for both alkene and carbene fragments and operation in solution or by solid-state ball milling. Mechanistically, the ylide functions as a controlled carbene precursor with thianthrene as the leaving fragment. The authors also demonstrate insertion and rearrangement-type reactivity, establishing thianthrenium salts as modular entry points to broader carbene-transfer chemistry.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06078.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究发展了 Ni 催化、导向基辅助的 C(sp³)–H 芳基化，用于高位阻环丙烷及其他环烷烃的 trans 选择性构建。8-aminoquinoline 型导向作用先形成顺式 nickelacycle，随后在反应条件下发生构型重排，最终偏向热力学更稳定的 trans 产物；KIE 接近 1，说明 C–H 断裂并非明显的速率决定步骤。方法兼容多种芳基碘化物并可扩展到其他环状骨架。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06078.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study develops nickel-catalyzed, directing-group-assisted C(sp3)–H arylation for trans-selective synthesis of sterically congested cyclopropanes and related cycloalkanes. An 8-aminoquinoline-type directing group first forms a cis nickelacycle, followed by configurational equilibration under the reaction conditions to favor the thermodynamically more stable trans product. A kinetic isotope effect close to 1 indicates that C–H cleavage is not strongly rate-determining. The method accommodates diverse aryl iodides and extends to additional cyclic frameworks.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03826.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该工作利用可见光将 1,7-烯炔与 α-溴羰基化合物进行自由基级联环化，一步构建 spirooxindole 衍生物并表现出较高非对映选择性。α-羰基自由基先加成烯炔体系，随后发生连续环化并伴随 1,5-氢迁移/重排形成螺环骨架。自由基捕获和控制实验支持自由基过程，为从线性烯炔快速提升分子复杂度提供了光化学策略。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03826.en: The captured evidence is partial. Visible-light activation couples 1,7-enynes with α-bromocarbonyl compounds in a radical cascade that constructs spirooxindole derivatives in one step with high diastereoselectivity. An α-carbonyl radical first adds to the enyne system, followed by sequential cyclization and a 1,5-hydrogen-transfer/rearrangement sequence that forms the spirocyclic framework. Radical trapping and control experiments support the radical pathway, providing a photochemical strategy for rapidly increasing molecular complexity from linear enynes.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03702.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究以 dienyne-amide 与二烷基溴丙二酸酯为起点，通过催化剂与温度控制实现杂环发散合成。Au 催化、较低温度时主要经历环异构化、环丙烷化和 1-aza-Cope 重排，得到 furan-fused dihydroazepine；升温可进一步导向螺环重排。Ag 条件则经另一类氧代三烯/乙烯基环丙烷重排进入不同螺环产物，体现了同一前体网络的条件可编程骨架编辑。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03702.en: The captured evidence is partial. Dienyne-amides and dialkyl bromomalonates undergo catalyst- and temperature-controlled divergent heterocycle synthesis. Under gold catalysis at lower temperature, cycloisomerization, cyclopropanation, and a 1-aza-Cope rearrangement lead mainly to furan-fused dihydroazepines, whereas heating promotes further rearrangement to spirocyclic products. Silver conditions access a distinct spirocyclic pathway through an oxotriene/vinyl-cyclopropane-type rearrangement, illustrating condition-programmable skeletal editing from a common precursor network.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01824.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究发展了无过渡金属、区域选择性的 tetrazole 构建方法。芳基偶氮砜与含氰基或膦酰基的重氮化合物在碱性条件下发生 [3+2] 型成环，分别得到氰基或膦酰基取代 tetrazole。控制实验表明芳基偶氮砜比常见偶氮试剂更适合作为该成环伙伴；该方法从易得含氮前体直接构建多官能化 tetrazole，为后续含能/药化骨架拓展提供模块化入口。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01824.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study develops a transition-metal-free, regioselective route to tetrazoles. Arylazo sulfones react with cyano- or phosphonyl-substituted diazo compounds under basic conditions in a [3+2]-type annulation to furnish cyano- or phosphonyl-functionalized tetrazoles. Control experiments show that arylazo sulfones are more effective annulation partners than commonly used azo reagents. The method therefore provides a modular route from accessible nitrogen-rich precursors to multifunctional tetrazole scaffolds.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01805.zh: 该研究以 N-aryloxysulfonamide 与 2-bromoallyl sulfone 为原料，经“碱处理后酸处理”的顺序过程合成 2-(arylsulfonylmethyl)benzofuran。机理实验支持先发生形式亲核乙烯基取代并形成 allenyl sulfone 型中间体，继而经历 [3,3]-重排和缩合/环化建立 benzofuran 核。反应可在温和条件下进行，产物保留磺酰甲基官能团，便于进一步烷基化、卤化和交叉偶联衍生化。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01805.en: This study synthesizes 2-(arylsulfonylmethyl)benzofurans from N-aryloxysulfonamides and 2-bromoallyl sulfones through sequential base and acid treatment. Mechanistic experiments support an initial formal nucleophilic vinylic substitution leading to an allenyl-sulfone-type intermediate, followed by a [3,3]-rearrangement and condensation/cyclization to establish the benzofuran core. The reaction proceeds under mild conditions and leaves a sulfonylmethyl handle that can be further elaborated by alkylation, halogenation, and cross-coupling.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01791.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究建立了 Pandanus 生物碱的模块化集体全合成。Cu(I) 催化的多组分反应从碘代丙烯酸、端炔和一级胺构建 γ-hydroxy-γ-lactam 关键中间体，随后借助 N-acyliminium 化学快速进入 diazaspirocyclic 骨架。该路线完成 Pandanusine A、Pandanusine B 和 Pandamarine 的合成，并通过 VCD/ECD 与计算辅助确认关键立体化学，展示了同一模块化中间体通向多个天然产物的能力。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01791.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study establishes a modular collective synthesis of Pandanus alkaloids. A Cu(I)-catalyzed multicomponent reaction of iodoacrylic acids, terminal alkynes, and primary amines provides γ-hydroxy-γ-lactam intermediates, which are then converted through N-acyliminium chemistry into diazaspirocyclic frameworks. The route delivers Pandanusine A, Pandanusine B, and Pandamarine, with VCD/ECD and computation used to support key stereochemical assignments, demonstrating how a shared modular intermediate can access multiple natural products.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01517.zh: 该工作发展了 o-anilinopropargyl alcohol、醛和缩醛试剂的一锅酸催化反应，在室温构建 3-methylidene-2,3-dihydro-4-quinolone。机理研究支持先经缩醛捕获的 Meyer–Schuster 型重排形成活化中间体，随后发生 1,3-迁移、分子内加成和甲氧基离去完成杂环化。方法覆盖多种取代底物，并把炔丙醇、醛和苯胺片段在单一操作中汇聚为高度官能化 quinolone 骨架。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01517.en: This work develops a one-pot acid-catalyzed reaction of o-anilinopropargyl alcohols, aldehydes, and an acetal reagent to construct 3-methylidene-2,3-dihydro-4-quinolones at room temperature. Mechanistic studies support an acetal-intercepted Meyer–Schuster-type rearrangement to an activated intermediate, followed by 1,3-migration, intramolecular addition, and methoxy elimination to complete heterocyclization. The method tolerates varied substitution patterns and converges propargylic-alcohol, aldehyde, and aniline fragments into highly functionalized quinolone scaffolds in a single operation.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01447.zh: 该研究建立了电化学一锅法，可把烷基芳烃中的 C(sp³)–X 键转化与芳环 C(sp²)–H 酰氧基化串联起来，并实现多类羰基、酯和含硫衍生物的发散制备。体系无需过渡金属和化学氧化剂，氨的加入有助于电解质溶解和导电。控制实验支持阳极生成酰氧自由基并参与氢原子转移/后续氧化过程，使同一电解平台可通过条件选择实现多种 C–X/C–O 键重组。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01447.en: This study establishes an electrochemical one-pot platform that combines C(sp3)–X bond transformation of alkylarenes with aryl C(sp2)–H acyloxylation, enabling divergent preparation of carbonyl, ester, and sulfur-containing derivatives. The process does not require a transition metal or chemical oxidant, and added ammonia improves electrolyte solubility and conductivity. Control experiments support anodic formation of acyloxy radicals that participate in hydrogen-atom transfer and downstream oxidation, allowing multiple C–X/C–O bond-reorganization outcomes from a common electrochemical platform.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01127.zh: 该研究发展了 Pd 催化的 Proc 保护胍快速脱笼方法，在无需膦配体的条件下选择性释放胍基。与常见 Alloc 型保护基相比，Proc-caged guanidine 在该催化体系中表现出更快响应，并适用于芳香族和脂肪族胍底物。机理实验支持邻近胍氮对 Pd 的自配位/招募作用加速脱保护；作者还在活细胞荧光释放实验中展示了分钟级响应，为时空控制胍功能提供了化学生物学工具。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01127.en: This study develops rapid palladium-catalyzed decaging of Proc-protected guanidines without a phosphine ligand. Proc-caged guanidines respond faster than common Alloc-type protecting groups under the catalytic conditions and the method applies to both aromatic and aliphatic guanidines. Mechanistic experiments support self-coordination/recruitment of palladium by a neighboring guanidine nitrogen as a contributor to the accelerated deprotection. The authors also demonstrate minute-scale fluorophore release in living cells, providing a chemical-biology tool for temporal control of guanidine functionality.

10.1021/jacs.6c14997.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究通过共同中间体和发散后期步骤完成 Miophytocen D、Roridin E、Verrucarin J 与 Verrucarol 的不对称合成。路线以 exo-Diels–Alder、仿生氧杂环化、构象控制的烯烃–环氧化物环化以及环闭合复分解等关键步骤建立多个手性中心和宏环。工作实现 Miophytocen D 的首次全合成，并以较大规模制备 Verrucarol，同时为相关天然产物的生物合成联系提供实验支持。
10.1021/jacs.6c14997.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study accomplishes asymmetric syntheses of Miophytocen D, Roridin E, Verrucarin J, and Verrucarol through shared intermediates and divergent late-stage steps. Key transformations include an exo-Diels–Alder reaction, biomimetic oxacyclization, conformation-controlled alkene–epoxide cyclization, and ring-closing metathesis to establish the stereochemical and macrocyclic architecture. The work provides the first total synthesis of Miophytocen D, prepares Verrucarol on useful scale, and offers experimental support for biosynthetic relationships among the natural products.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03878.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究利用手性芳硫醇催化可见光不对称氢二氟烷基化，将亚甲基茚烷等烯烃与 α-溴二氟酰胺类自由基前体偶联，获得高对映选择性的二氟烷基化产物。机理分析表明手性硫醇参与关键 HAT 步骤，底物 gem-dimethyl 构型可放大过渡态能量差，而底物 N-芳基与催化剂芳环之间的非共价作用进一步帮助立体区分。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03878.en: The captured evidence is partial. A chiral arylthiol catalyst enables visible-light-driven asymmetric hydrodifluoroalkylation of alkenes such as methyleneindanes with α-bromodifluoroamide radical precursors, giving difluoroalkylated products with high enantioselectivity. Mechanistic analysis indicates that the chiral thiol participates in the stereochemistry-determining HAT step; a gem-dimethyl motif amplifies the transition-state energy difference, while noncovalent interactions between the substrate N-aryl group and the catalyst arene further assist stereodifferentiation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03717.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展了 Ni 催化的还原烷基化，使无需额外导向基的 N-磺酰基或 N-芳基醛亚胺与未活化一级、二级和三级烷基碘化物偶联，并可兼容部分活化烷基溴化物。摘要显示该方法适用于复杂烷基片段、可放大，并可进入 β-氨基酯等产物；机理结果支持可生成烷基自由基并以外球方式加成亚胺。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写未捕获的实验细节。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03717.en: Abstract-based: this study develops nickel-catalyzed reductive alkylation of directing-group-free N-sulfonyl or N-aryl aldimines with unactivated primary, secondary, and tertiary alkyl iodides, as well as selected activated alkyl bromides. The abstract reports compatibility with complex alkyl fragments, scale-up, and access to products including β-amino esters; mechanistic results support generation of alkyl radicals followed by outer-sphere addition to the imine. Because only abstract-level evidence is available, uncaptured experimental details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03451.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究提出按二硫键“结构架构”进行顺序编辑的方法，在未保护多肽中利用芳基、乙基和叔丁基二硫键不同的内在反应性，匹配不同活化条件实现选择性逐步转化，而无需传统保护/脱保护循环。捕获证据还显示芳香二硫键可通过膦酸酯体系进行正交转化。该策略把二硫键从单一保护单元转化为可编程的化学把手，适合复杂肽的位点选择性编辑。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03451.en: The captured evidence is partial. This work introduces architecture-guided sequential editing of disulfides in unprotected peptides by exploiting the distinct intrinsic reactivities of aryl, ethyl, and tert-butyl disulfides and matching them with selective activation conditions. The sequence avoids conventional protection/deprotection cycles, and the captured evidence also shows orthogonal transformation of aromatic disulfides with a phosphite-based system. The strategy turns disulfides from passive protecting motifs into programmable chemical handles for site-selective editing of complex peptides.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03250.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究发展了光氧化还原/Ni 双催化的去硼不对称 Suzuki–Miyaura 偶联，使外消旋烷基硼酸酯与杂芳基或芳基卤化物发生对映汇聚 C(sp³)–C(sp²) 成键。体系兼容多类杂芳基溴化物，并通过电子受体型杂芳烃促进烷基硼酸酯单电子活化生成自由基；随后由手性 Ni 催化循环完成立体选择性偶联。该方法为常见烷基硼酸酯直接转化为手性杂芳基烷烃提供了模块化路径。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03250.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study develops a dual photoredox/nickel deboronative asymmetric Suzuki–Miyaura coupling that converts racemic alkylboronic esters and heteroaryl or aryl halides into C(sp3)–C(sp2) products through enantioconvergence. The system accommodates diverse heteroaryl bromides, while electron-deficient heteroarenes assist single-electron activation of the alkylboronic ester to generate an alkyl radical. A chiral nickel cycle then performs the stereoselective cross-coupling, providing a modular route from common alkylboronic esters to chiral heteroaryl-substituted alkanes.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01925.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究以 N-cyano sulfonamide 类试剂为氰胺来源，发展活化烯烃/炔烃的氢氰胺化，从而合成多取代 cyanamide。反应无需过渡金属，氟化物/碱体系促进 N–CN 试剂活化和对不饱和受体的加成；捕获证据显示方法适用于多类活化烯烃和炔烃，并可进行克级反应与复杂分子后期引入。该策略提供了直接构建可继续衍生的 N-取代 cyanamide 官能团的方法。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01925.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study uses N-cyano sulfonamide-type reagents as cyanamide sources for hydrocyanamidation of activated alkenes and alkynes, furnishing substituted cyanamides. The transition-metal-free process uses a fluoride/base system to activate the N–CN reagent and promote addition to the unsaturated acceptor. The captured evidence shows applicability to multiple activated alkene and alkyne classes, gram-scale operation, and late-stage installation on complex molecules, providing direct access to N-substituted cyanamides that can be further elaborated.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01880.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究发现不饱和内酯在氰化物作用下发生非常规骨架重排，可形成含醚、腈和内酰胺官能团的三环 furopyrrolidinone。产物类型受氰化物当量和底物结构影响，实验显示体系可能经历多次 CN 加成及随后的开环/重组；单晶结构用于确认代表性产物的连接方式和立体化学。该反应揭示了高不饱和内酯在亲核条件下可被深度重编辑为致密三环骨架。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01880.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study finds that unsaturated lactones undergo an unusual cyanide-mediated skeletal rearrangement to tricyclic furopyrrolidinones containing ether, nitrile, and lactam functionalities. Product outcome depends on cyanide stoichiometry and substrate structure, and the experiments indicate multiple CN additions followed by ring opening/reorganization. Single-crystal structures establish the connectivity and stereochemistry of representative products. The reaction reveals that highly unsaturated lactones can undergo deep nucleophile-driven skeletal editing to compact tricyclic frameworks.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01197.zh: 该研究以手性 prolinol 支持的四配位 Al 阳离子为催化剂，实现 3-取代吲哚 C2–H 键活化并对烯酮进行对映选择性 Michael 加成，无需在受体上设置专门螯合基。化学计量 NMR 观察到与催化循环一致的 Al 物种，而封闭配体胺位点会明显抑制反应；动力学与计算结果支持配体辅助的 CMD 型 C–H 活化。该工作展示了主族 Lewis 酸催化直接不对称 C–H 官能化的可行性。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01197.en: This study uses a chiral prolinol-supported tetracoordinate aluminum cation to activate the C2–H bond of 3-substituted indoles and promote enantioselective Michael addition to enones without requiring a dedicated chelating group on the acceptor. Stoichiometric NMR detects aluminum species consistent with the catalytic cycle, while blocking the ligand amine strongly suppresses reactivity. Kinetic and computational results support a ligand-assisted CMD-type C–H activation, demonstrating the feasibility of direct asymmetric C–H functionalization with a main-group Lewis-acid catalyst.

10.1021/jacs.6c14478.zh: 该研究发展了光诱导 Ni 催化的对映汇聚反应，将乙烯基环丙烷与醛偶联为带季碳手性中心的 allylic 1,3-diol。反应同时控制区域、非对映和对映选择性，并适用于多类醛和乙烯基环丙烷。光物理和机理研究支持还原淬灭产生催化活性 Ni 物种，手性单核 Ni 中间体负责立体控制；作者提出氧化加成是关键慢步骤之一，而亲核 allyl–Ni 与醛成键建立核心 C–C 键。
10.1021/jacs.6c14478.en: This study develops a photoinduced nickel-catalyzed enantioconvergent coupling of vinyl cyclopropanes with aldehydes to form allylic 1,3-diols bearing a quaternary stereocenter. The reaction simultaneously controls regio-, diastereo-, and enantioselectivity and is applicable to varied aldehydes and vinyl cyclopropanes. Photophysical and mechanistic studies support reductive quenching to generate catalytically active nickel species, with a chiral monomeric nickel intermediate governing stereocontrol. The authors identify oxidative addition as a key slow step and propose C–C bond formation through addition of a nucleophilic allyl–Ni species to the aldehyde.

10.1021/jacs.6c14022.zh: 该研究报道 Cu 催化、由环张力驱动的对映专一 C–C 氧化加成，并将 gem-difluorocyclopropane 与苯胺转化为支链 fluoroallylamine。机理证据支持 Cu 对环丙烷 C–C 键发生氧化加成，随后通过协同取代型还原消除和 β-F 消除完成 C–N 成键及开环；底物立体信息以可预测方式转移到产物。该模式绕开传统 allyl–metal 中间体，为张力小环的立体专一交叉偶联提供了新的基元反应。
10.1021/jacs.6c14022.en: This study reports copper-catalyzed, strain-driven enantiospecific C–C oxidative addition that converts gem-difluorocyclopropanes and anilines into branched fluoroallylamines. Mechanistic evidence supports oxidative addition of copper into the cyclopropane C–C bond, followed by a concerted substitution-type reductive elimination and β-fluoride elimination to form the C–N bond and open the ring. Stereochemical information from the substrate is transferred predictably to the product, establishing a new elementary mode for enantiospecific cross-coupling of strained rings without a conventional allyl–metal pathway.

10.1021/jacs.6c13291.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究通过刻意降低 Schiff-base COF 的缩合速率，捕获并表征毫米级有序中间体，从而直接追踪 β-ketoenamine COF 的组装过程。该中间体可在无需额外催化剂或调节剂的热处理下继续转化为最终 COF。结果表明单体内在反应性和动力学减速决定了可观测中间体的形成，并为理解二维框架从分子缩合到长程有序结构的演化提供了实验窗口。
10.1021/jacs.6c13291.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study deliberately decelerates Schiff-base condensation during β-ketoenamine COF formation, allowing millimeter-scale ordered intermediates to be isolated and characterized. The intermediate can then be thermally converted into the final COF without an additional catalyst or modulator. The results show that intrinsic monomer reactivity and kinetic slowing govern formation of observable intermediates, providing an experimental window into how molecular condensation evolves into long-range order during two-dimensional framework assembly.

10.1021/jacs.6c12207.zh: 该研究通过调节 Co 碳基电催化剂中 Co⁰/CoOx 的氧化态平衡，实现含氮芳香化合物的选择性加氢。以吡啶为代表底物，在阴离子交换膜电解体系中可高选择性生成哌啶；原位 XAFS 显示催化过程中 Co 氧化态动态变化，并支持吡啶与表面氢共同吸附的 Langmuir–Hinshelwood 路径。间歇电解可避免金属位点过度还原并维持活性，方法还适用于多种 N-杂芳烃。
10.1021/jacs.6c12207.en: This study controls the Co0/CoOx balance in a cobalt/carbon electrocatalyst to achieve selective hydrogenation of nitrogen-containing aromatics. Pyridine is converted selectively to piperidine in an anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzer, while operando XAFS reveals dynamic cobalt oxidation-state changes during catalysis and supports a Langmuir–Hinshelwood pathway involving coadsorbed pyridine and surface hydrogen. Intermittent electrolysis prevents excessive reduction of the cobalt sites and maintains activity, and the approach extends to multiple N-heteroarenes.

10.1038/s41929-026-01616-6.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究通过机理导向的配体设计扩展 Ni(I) 催化芳基溴化物 C(sp²)–杂原子偶联。dpabpy 类配体与强有机碱组合可从稳定 Ni(II) 前体直接在可见光下生成反应性 Ni(I) 物种，并支持 N、O、S、P 等多类亲核体偶联，部分反应可在极低 Ni 负载下进行。光谱/计算结果表明配体需要在“足够活化 Ni(I)”与“稳定 Ni(II)-配体自由基”之间取得平衡；部分杂芳基 N 偶联仍会受质子脱卤限制。
10.1038/s41929-026-01616-6.en: The captured evidence is partial. Mechanistically guided ligand design broadens Ni(I)-catalyzed C(sp2)–heteroatom coupling of aryl bromides. A dpabpy-type ligand combined with a strong organic base enables direct visible-light generation of reactive Ni(I) from a stable Ni(II) precursor and supports coupling with N-, O-, S-, and P-nucleophiles, including reactions at very low nickel loading. Spectroscopic and computational results indicate that the ligand must balance sufficient Ni(I) reactivity with stabilization of a Ni(II) ligand-radical state, while some heteroaryl N-couplings remain limited by protodehalogenation.

10.1021/jacs.6c09785.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用有序 ABC 三嵌段共聚物中的 gyroid 相，将其中一个网络选择性固定为三维模板，再在凝胶态对不同嵌段进行选择性胺化或磺化，构建空间分辨的化学功能区。摘要显示材料在功能化后可表现显著溶胀并形成聚两性电解质行为，说明预组织的纳米尺度形貌可以被转化为位置可编程的化学环境。当前仅有 Abstract 级证据，因此不补写未捕获的制备或表征细节。
10.1021/jacs.6c09785.en: Abstract-based: this study uses the gyroid morphology of an ordered ABC triblock terpolymer, selectively crosslinking one network as a three-dimensional template and then performing block-selective amination or sulfonation in the gel state to create spatially defined chemical domains. The abstract reports pronounced swelling after functionalization and polyampholyte behavior, showing that a preorganized nanoscale morphology can be converted into a position-programmable chemical environment. Because only abstract-level evidence is available, uncaptured preparation and characterization details are not reconstructed.

10.1021/acscatal.6c06753.zh: 该研究发展了光氧化还原/Co 双催化驱动的 Kharasch 型加成与 cotelomerization，用于合成 α-chlorocarbonyl 化合物。体系可通过不同方式生成烷基自由基，自由基先加成 Michael 受体，随后由 Co–Cl 物种进行氯原子转移捕获，从而形成新的 C–C 与 C–Cl 键。方法兼容多类自由基前体和受体，并可串联多次加成；作者同时指出 MHAT 条件对某些脂肪族或电子缺陷烯烃的化学选择性仍有限。
10.1021/acscatal.6c06753.en: This study develops photoredox/cobalt dual catalysis for Kharasch-type addition and cotelomerization to synthesize α-chlorocarbonyl compounds. Alkyl radicals can be generated by several entry modes, add first to a Michael acceptor, and are then trapped by chlorine-atom transfer from a cobalt chloride species to form new C–C and C–Cl bonds. The method accommodates multiple radical precursors and acceptors and can support sequential additions, while the authors also identify chemoselectivity limitations for selected aliphatic or electron-deficient alkenes under MHAT conditions.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03465.zh: 当前证据为部分正文。该研究实现了可见光介导的 furan 到 pyridazine 骨架编辑，可视为 O 原子被 N–N 单元替换的形式原子对交换。hydrazine hydrate 在室温、空气条件下与二、三、四取代 furan 反应，表现出较好的底物兼容性和区域控制，并可用于克级和复杂分子后期转化。控制实验表明水有助于抑制 hydrazine 的副反应，氧气衍生活性物种参与光化学过程。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03465.en: The captured evidence is partial. This study achieves visible-light-mediated skeletal editing of furans to pyridazines, formally replacing the furan oxygen atom with an N–N unit. Hydrazine hydrate reacts with di-, tri-, and tetrasubstituted furans at room temperature under air with broad substrate compatibility and strong regiocontrol, and the method is demonstrated on gram scale and in late-stage transformations. Control experiments indicate that water helps suppress unproductive hydrazine reactivity and that oxygen-derived reactive species participate in the photochemical process.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01817.zh: 该研究报道 amycomycin（vancoresmycin 的 aglycon）C24-去甲基类似物的汇聚式合成，并重点解决高度拥挤片段之间的连接问题。最初设想通过醛/酮 aldol 加成–消除构建中央 C23–C25 enone；模型体系可行，但在高度官能化真实片段上因位阻而无法完成消除，因此作者将逆合成断键改到 C23–C24。成功路线以 vinyl iodide 为关键中间体，经 Li/I 交换形成乙烯基亲核体后与醛进行汇聚偶联；同时利用 Boron–Wittig olefination 构建位阻显著的 vinyl boronate。路线末端再引入 tetramic acid，并通过复杂 3-acyl tetramic acid 的 O→C 酰基迁移完成完整骨架。该工作表明，对于这类高氧化态、强位阻 polyketide，改变汇聚断键位置与把 tetramic-acid 重排后移到末期，可显著提高路线可行性。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01817.en: The study reports a convergent synthesis of a C24-desmethyl analogue of amycomycin, the aglycon of vancoresmycin, with emphasis on solving a highly congested fragment-coupling problem. An initial aldehyde/ketone aldol-addition–elimination plan for the central C23–C25 enone worked in model systems but failed on advanced fragments because steric congestion prevented productive elimination. The retrosynthetic disconnection was therefore shifted to C23–C24. In the successful route, a vinyl iodide serves as the pivotal intermediate; Li/I exchange generates a vinyl nucleophile for convergent addition to the aldehyde, while a Boron–Wittig olefination provides access to sterically congested vinyl boronates. Tetramic acid is introduced late, followed by an O-to-C acyl transfer on the complex 3-acyl tetramic acid to complete the desmethyl amycomycin skeleton. The work shows how changing the convergent bond construction and postponing tetramic-acid rearrangement can unlock densely functionalized, sterically demanding polyketide targets.

10.1002/anie.8317220.zh: 该研究利用 triplet–triplet annihilation photon upconversion（TTA-UC）把低能绿光转换为可触发 photoclick 的蓝光，从而避免传统 9,10-phenanthrenequinone–electron-rich alkene（PQ–ERA）反应对 UV/深蓝光的依赖。代表性体系以 PdOEP 为 sensitizer、DPA 为 annihilator，在 550 nm LED、50 mW cm−2 下运行；绿光先激发 PdOEP，经三重态能量转移和 TTA 生成 DPA 单重激发态及蓝光，再被 PQ 吸收并启动 [2+2] photoclick。该 PdOEP/DPA 体系最高 upconversion quantum yield 达 17.2%，在 50 mW cm−2 下仍为 5.3%；photoclick 可在约 5 min 内完成，kobs 最高约 0.015 s−1。作者还验证了另一套 BODIPY/perylene TTA-UC 组合，并通过 PEG 包封把反应拓展到水相、不同 pH 和 hydrogel 环境。
10.1002/anie.8317220.en: The study uses triplet–triplet annihilation photon upconversion (TTA-UC) to convert low-energy green light into blue photons capable of driving 9,10-phenanthrenequinone–electron-rich alkene (PQ–ERA) photoclick reactions, avoiding the usual dependence on UV or deep-blue excitation. A representative system employs PdOEP as the sensitizer and DPA as the annihilator under a 550 nm LED at 50 mW cm−2. Green-light excitation of PdOEP is followed by triplet energy transfer and TTA to generate the DPA singlet state and blue emission, which overlaps the PQ absorption and triggers the photoclick event. The PdOEP/DPA system reaches an upconversion quantum yield of 17.2% and still gives 5.3% at 50 mW cm−2; the photoclick reaction can finish within about 5 min with kobs up to approximately 0.015 s−1. A second BODIPY/perylene TTA-UC pair was also demonstrated, and PEG encapsulation enabled aqueous reactions across different pH values and in hydrogel matrices.

10.1002/anie.8267819.zh: 该研究发展 Pd 催化不对称 bisallylation/环闭复分解串联，由简单 coumarin 衍生的三取代烯烃快速构建带相邻三级/全碳四级立体中心的 steroid-like 多环骨架。核心步骤使用空气稳定的 allyl potassium trifluoroborate 与商业 allyl acetate，在新设计的手性 biaryl monophosphine/Pd2(dba)3 体系中一次安装两个 allyl 单元；模型底物经优化在 CPME、30 °C、48 h 下可得 95% 收率、95:5 er 和 >20:1 dr，随后加入 Grubbs II 催化剂完成 RCM。产物保留烯烃和酯等可继续衍生的官能团。计算研究表明，顺序反应中 bis-π-allylpalladium 中间体的形成是速率决定步骤。该催化体系还可用于 cyclic N-sulfonyl imine，生成手性 homoallylic amine 和更复杂的含氮多环骨架。
10.1002/anie.8267819.en: The study develops a Pd-catalyzed asymmetric bisallylation/ring-closing-metathesis sequence that rapidly converts simple coumarin-derived trisubstituted alkenes into steroid-like polycycles bearing adjacent tertiary and all-carbon quaternary stereocenters. The key bisallylation uses air-stable allyl potassium trifluoroborate and commercial allyl acetate to install two allyl groups under a newly designed chiral biaryl-monophosphine/Pd2(dba)3 system. For the optimized model substrate, CPME at 30 °C for 48 h gives the bisallylation product in 95% yield, 95:5 er, and >20:1 dr, after which Grubbs II catalysis closes the ring. The products retain alkene and ester handles for further diversification. Computations identify formation of the bis-π-allylpalladium intermediate as the rate-determining step of the sequential process. The catalyst system is also applicable to cyclic N-sulfonyl imines, providing chiral homoallylic amines and more complex nitrogen-containing polycyclic frameworks.

10.1002/anie.6888467.zh: 该研究实现 Pd(0) 催化的 thiazole N-oxide C4 位直接 atroposelective C–H arylation，以无需预官能化的 C–H/aryl bromide 偶联直接建立 heterobiaryl 手性轴。反应的关键是作者设计的 point- and axially chiral 单膦配体 L12；代表性优化条件为约 5 mol% Pd、10 mol% L12、30 mol% PivOH、Cs2CO3、toluene、80 °C，模型产物可达 93% 分离收率和 93:7 er。未氧化的对应 thiazole 在相同体系中不反应，显示 N-oxide 对提高 1,3-azole C–H arylation 反应性至关重要。平行 KIE 仅约 1.2，结合 PivOH 对速率而非 ee 的影响，支持 carboxylate-assisted CMD 型 C–H 活化且其并非 turnover-limiting。方法兼容多类 aryl/heteroaryl bromide，并可克级放大；N-oxide 后续还原不会导致手性轴消旋。
10.1002/anie.6888467.en: The study achieves Pd(0)-catalyzed direct atroposelective C4 C–H arylation of thiazole N-oxides, creating heterobiaryl stereogenic axes without prefunctionalizing the heteroarene C–H partner. A designer point- and axially chiral monophosphine ligand, L12, is central to both reactivity and stereocontrol. Representative optimized conditions use about 5 mol% Pd, 10 mol% L12, 30 mol% PivOH, Cs2CO3, and toluene at 80 °C, affording the model atropisomer in 93% isolated yield and 93:7 er. The corresponding unoxidized thiazole is unreactive under the same conditions, showing the importance of N-oxide activation for 1,3-azole C–H arylation. A parallel KIE of only about 1.2, together with the effect of PivOH on rate but not enantioselectivity, supports a carboxylate-assisted CMD-type C–H activation that is unlikely to be turnover-limiting. The method accommodates aryl and heteroaryl bromides, scales to gram quantities, and permits N-oxide reduction without racemization of the chiral axis.

10.1002/anie.6111891.zh: 该研究建立 Co 催化环状 1,2- 与 1,3-diacid anhydride 的不对称去对称化氢化，可直接获得高对映富集的 γ- 和 δ-lactone，最高达 99% ee，并覆盖不同环尺寸、非环底物、含氮底物及 bridged anhydride。优化体系以 CoBr2/手性 diphosphine 为核心；代表性条件为 3 mol% Co、3 mol% ligand、THF、80 °C、80 bar H2、24 h，并需要还原剂活化前催化剂。不同底物可在 (S)-Binapine 与 (R,R)-Ph-BPE 等配体之间匹配以维持高选择性，且多种药物/天然产物相关 lactone 可克级制备。DFT 指向 d7 Co(II) dihydride 为活性物种，氢化走 outer-sphere hydride-transfer，而不是依赖底物强配位的 inner-sphere 路径；作者据此解释其对结构差异明显的 anhydride 仍具有较广底物适用性。
10.1002/anie.6111891.en: The study establishes cobalt-catalyzed asymmetric desymmetrizing hydrogenation of cyclic 1,2- and 1,3-diacid anhydrides, providing highly enantioenriched γ- and δ-lactones with up to 99% ee. The scope includes different ring sizes, an acyclic substrate, an N-heterocyclic substrate, and bridged anhydrides. The optimized platform is based on CoBr2 and a chiral diphosphine; representative conditions use 3 mol% Co, 3 mol% ligand, THF, 80 °C, 80 bar H2, and 24 h, with reductive precatalyst activation required. Ligands such as (S)-Binapine and (R,R)-Ph-BPE are matched to different substrate classes to maintain high stereoselectivity, and several pharmaceutically or natural-product-relevant lactones are prepared on gram scale. DFT identifies a d7 Co(II) dihydride as the catalytically active species and supports an outer-sphere hydride-transfer pathway rather than a coordination-dependent inner-sphere mechanism, which the authors use to rationalize the broad structural tolerance.

10.1002/anie.4546692.zh: 该研究完成与肠道菌 Ruminococcus gnavus 多糖相关的支化 glucorhamnan 五糖、十糖和二十糖的立体选择性化学合成，并进一步研究其构象与促炎活性。路线以 orthogonally protected 五糖重复单元为核心：rhamnan 主链中的 1,2-trans 键借助邻基参与控制，而连接 isomaltose 侧链的拥挤 1,2-cis-α-glucosidic 键是主要难点。初始全 benzyl 保护的 disaccharide donor 易发生 1,6 键断裂；把 C6 保护基改为电子吸拉的 benzoyl 后，[3+2] glycosylation 可在 90% 收率、单一 α 选择性下得到关键五糖。随后通过 Yu glycosylation 迭代延长得到十糖与二十糖。NMR 与 MD 显示这些 glucorhamnan 形成延展的左手螺旋构象并规律暴露 isomaltose 侧链；合成寡糖可诱导 BMDC 释放 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-12，其中 TNF-α 响应在等摩尔比较时随糖链增长而增强。
10.1002/anie.4546692.en: The study completes stereoselective chemical syntheses of branched glucorhamnan penta-, deca-, and eicosaccharides related to the polysaccharide of the gut bacterium Ruminococcus gnavus, followed by conformational and pro-inflammatory evaluation. The route is built around an orthogonally protected pentasaccharide repeat unit: neighboring-group participation controls the 1,2-trans linkages of the rhamnan backbone, whereas the sterically demanding 1,2-cis-α-glucosidic linkage connecting the isomaltose side chain is the central challenge. A fully benzyl-protected disaccharide donor undergoes problematic 1,6-bond fragmentation, but replacing the C6 protecting group with electron-withdrawing benzoyl enables the key [3+2] glycosylation in 90% yield with exclusive α selectivity. Iterative Yu glycosylation then gives the deca- and eicosaccharides. NMR and MD analyses show an extended left-handed helicoidal conformation with regular exposure of the isomaltose side chains. The synthetic glycans induce TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-12 release from BMDCs, with TNF-α responses increasing with chain length on an equimolar basis.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05418.zh: 该研究发展 Cu/Pd 协同催化的 1,3-enyne allylboration，并利用 electrophile 身份控制化学/区域发散：普通 allyl carbonate 使反应选择性生成 borylated 1,4-enallene，而 dienyl carbonate 则把反应导向 propargylation，得到 1,3,7-dienyne。代表性 allyl-carbonate 条件使用 B2pin2 1.5 equiv、CuCl 5 mol%、Pd(dba)2 5 mol%、DavePhos 15 mol%、toluene、50 °C、16 h；dienyl-carbonate 分支则使用 CyJohnPhos，并在 60 °C 约 4 h 完成。两类反应均表现出较高区域/立体选择性，并提供可继续转化的 organoboronate。DFT 指向共同的 η3-allyl–η1-allenyl Pd 中间体：allyl 派生中间体发生 1,1′-型 reductive elimination 形成四取代 allene，而 vinyl-substituted allyl-Pd 更倾向发生分子内 propargylic addition，由此解释 electrophile-controlled 分流。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05418.en: The study develops a Cu/Pd-catalyzed allylboration of 1,3-enynes in which the electrophile controls chemo- and regiochemical divergence. Simple allyl carbonates selectively furnish borylated 1,4-enallenes, whereas dienyl carbonates redirect the reaction toward propargylation to give 1,3,7-dienynes. Representative allyl-carbonate conditions use 1.5 equiv B2pin2, 5 mol% CuCl, 5 mol% Pd(dba)2, 15 mol% DavePhos, toluene, 50 °C, and 16 h; the dienyl-carbonate branch uses CyJohnPhos and proceeds at 60 °C over about 4 h. Both manifolds provide synthetically useful organoboronates with high regio- and stereoselectivity. DFT supports a common η3-allyl–η1-allenyl Pd intermediate: the allyl-derived species undergoes 1,1′-type reductive elimination to form the tetrasubstituted allene, whereas the vinyl-substituted allyl-Pd species preferentially undergoes intramolecular propargylic addition, accounting for the electrophile-controlled switch in product class.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05353.zh: 该研究报道 Ir 催化的跨酰胺骨架烯烃迁移，直接把亲电性的 α,β-unsaturated amide 转化为亲核性的 enamide。该过程不是沿连续碳链 chain-walking，而是利用 amide 两侧彼此分离的片段进行分子内氢转移；不需要外加氢源，整体 redox-neutral、atom-economical，且不依赖强碱。模型反应的优化条件为 [Ir(COD)2]NTf2 10 mol%、双膦 L1 12 mol%、Cs2CO3 1.3 equiv、PhF、130 °C、5 h，目标 enamide 以 93% NMR 收率形成。体系兼容 benzyl ether、silane、thioether、CF3、CN、sulfone 等多种官能团。机理研究支持不可逆的 intramolecular hydrogen-transfer pathway，而非传统链行走异构化；作者还获得了不对称分子内 transfer hydrogenation 的初步结果。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05353.en: The study reports an Ir-catalyzed alkene translocation across an amide linkage that directly converts electrophilic α,β-unsaturated amides into nucleophilic enamides. Rather than chain walking along a continuous carbon framework, the reaction transfers hydrogen intramolecularly between two segments separated by the amide; it requires no external hydrogen source and is redox-neutral, atom-economical, and free of strong base. Optimized model conditions use 10 mol% [Ir(COD)2]NTf2, 12 mol% diphosphine L1, 1.3 equiv Cs2CO3, PhF, 130 °C, and 5 h, affording the enamide in 93% NMR yield. Benzyl ether, silane, thioether, CF3, nitrile, sulfone, and other functional groups are tolerated. Mechanistic studies support an irreversible intramolecular hydrogen-transfer pathway rather than conventional chain-walking isomerization, and the authors also report preliminary success toward an enantioselective intramolecular transfer-hydrogenation variant.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03933.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究报道可见光介导的三组分串联脱羧双官能团化，以 glycosyl acid、styrene 和 cyanopyridine 一步组装多取代 C-alkyl glycoside。作者指出，该方法兼容多种 styrene、保护的 monosaccharide 与药物活性片段，并可进行克级制备。机理研究支持 glycosyl radical 参与的串联过程：glycosyl acid 经脱羧产生糖基自由基，随后参与 styrene 的多组分官能团化并与 pyridine 组分结合。该方法针对既有 C-glycoside 合成多以两组分偶联为主的局限，提供了以 styrene 为连接平台的三组分糖基化策略。由于当前证据仅为 Abstract，本摘要不补写未捕获的具体光催化剂、反应条件、逐项收率/选择性或更细机理控制实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03933.en: Abstract-based: the study reports a visible-light-mediated three-component tandem decarboxylative difunctionalization of glycosyl acids, styrenes, and cyanopyridines for one-step assembly of polysubstituted C-alkyl glycosides. The authors state that the method tolerates various styrenes, protected monosaccharides, and pharmaceutically active fragments and can be performed on gram scale. Mechanistic studies support a tandem pathway involving glycosyl radicals generated through decarboxylation, followed by multicomponent functionalization of the styrene and incorporation of the pyridine component. The strategy addresses the predominance of two-component couplings in C-glycoside synthesis by using styrene as a platform for three-component glycosylation. Because the current evidence is Abstract-only, this summary does not reconstruct uncaptured photocatalysts, detailed conditions, individual yields/selectivities, or additional mechanistic controls.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03918.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前抓取到的正文证据不完整，未捕获的底物范围和完整机理实验不作补写。该研究发展了 oxime ether 与 indole 衍生物的分子间可见光能量转移型 [2+2] cycloaddition，通过 indole dearomatization 快速构建同时含 indoline 与 azetidine 单元的稠合或桥环多环结构。作者以能量转移产生的 triplet-state indole 为反应逻辑基础，将此前主要见于分子内体系的 indole/imine 类 [2+2] 反应扩展到分子间版本，并需要控制 head-to-head/head-to-tail 区域选择性以及底物自二聚等竞争过程。已捕获的优化表显示，不同 photocatalyst 与溶剂会显著影响产率和区域异构体比例，部分条件可达到约 90% 级别产率。当前证据不足以可靠补写完整底物边界、各产物选择性及作者全部机理验证。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03918.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the captured full-text evidence is incomplete, so uncaptured substrate scope and the full mechanistic data set are not reconstructed. The study develops an intermolecular visible-light energy-transfer [2+2] cycloaddition of oxime ethers with indole derivatives, using indole dearomatization to rapidly build polycyclic products containing both indoline and azetidine units in fused or bridged architectures. The reaction design is based on energy-transfer generation of triplet-state indoles and extends indole/imine-type [2+2] chemistry, previously exemplified mainly by intramolecular systems, to an intermolecular setting where head-to-head/head-to-tail regioselectivity and substrate homodimerization must be controlled. The captured optimization table shows strong photocatalyst and solvent effects on yield and regioisomer ratio, with selected conditions reaching roughly 90% yield. The available evidence is insufficient to reconstruct the complete substrate boundaries, product-by-product selectivity, or all mechanistic validation experiments.
